params.body:
Two causes, one visible result: the screens were plainer than they were written
to be, every select had two chevrons, and the search box on the students screen
showed grey square corners poking out from behind a rounded field.

## 1. The dark-mode removal glued class names together

`2cce3797` ("remove dark mode", 9 December 2025) stripped the `dark:` variants
with a replacement that ate the separating space, so the dark class's opacity
modifier stuck to the light one:

```
- 'bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-500/10 dark:outline dark:outline-green-500/20'
+ 'bg-green-50/10/20'
```

Tailwind silently drops a utility it cannot parse, so nothing failed; the colour
simply stopped being emitted. **50 class names across 30 files**, and because the
shared components were among them the loss is everywhere:

| component | what it lost |
| --- | --- |
| `card-simple`, `card-footer`, `card-with-header` | `shadow-sm`, `sm:rounded-lg`, the footer's `bg-gray-50` |
| `badge` | all seven `ring-*-700/10` rings, and the backgrounds were washed to 10% alpha |
| `alert` | the green, red, yellow and blue tints |
| `layout/app` | the sidebar's `pb-4`, the header's `lg:px-8`, the avatar's outline, `xl:hidden` on the divider |
| `nav-link` | the active item's `text-gray-600` (it became `text-gray-600/5`) |
| `modal` | `transition-opacity` and `flex-col` on the panel |
| six list screens | `divide-gray-100` on the row dividers |
| `input`, `select`, `textarea` | `sm:text-sm/6` |

Every correction here is read off the `-` line of that commit, so each one is the
light-mode class the file had before the pass. Nothing is invented and nothing is
redesigned. A check that finds them: no token in `resources/` outside a URL
carries two slashes any more.

## 2. The forms plugin and the components drew the same box twice

`@plugin "@tailwindcss/forms"` runs in its base strategy, so it restyles every
`input`, `select` and `textarea` on the page: a 1px grey border, a square radius,
a blue focus ring, and for a `select` its own chevron as a background image.

That plugin was declared in `tailwind.config.js` until the Vite migration, which
Tailwind 4 no longer reads, so it had been doing nothing; it was restored in
`c9948c47` (2 August) because the checkboxes need it. It reached production with
tonight's deploy, which is why the doubling is new today.

The three form components carry their own design in utilities: `appearance-none`
plus an inline chevron `svg`, `outline-*` instead of `border-*`, a grey focus
outline. So the two versions were drawn on top of each other. They now switch
the plugin's version off for themselves (`border-0`, `focus:ring-0`, and
`bg-none` on the select) and the plugin keeps doing what it was brought back for,
which is the checkboxes.

`search-input` had a third variant of the same problem: the wrapper drew a square
outline while the `x-form.input` inside drew its own rounded one. The box is now
drawn once, on the wrapper, and the field inside carries no border, radius or
outline of its own. Focus moves to the wrapper with `focus-within`.

## Verified in a browser, not by reading

Both states were built and rendered against the real stylesheet. Before: the
select shows the plugin's chevron and the component's chevron side by side, and
the search field sits inside a square outline with its corners showing. After:
one chevron, one box, badges with solid tints and rings, cards with their shadow
back.

## Checks

- `npm run build`, `npm run lint -- --max-warnings=12`: 0 errors, 12 warnings
  (all pre-existing `vue/require-prop-types`).
- `php artisan test`: 196 passed, 1 failed (`BuildStampTest`, which needs a full
  clone rather than a worktree).
- `vendor/bin/phpstan analyse`: no errors. `vendor/bin/pint --test`: passed.
params.title: Vijftig kapotte klassenamen, en een dubbele chevron
